arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.XCL_031 > 10000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM account a
          JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
          WHERE a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
            AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
            AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.XCL_035) IN ('1996', '1997')
      )
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) AS yr,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN eligible_districts ed ON a.XCL_002 = ed.XCL_017
    WHERE t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048)
)
SELECT 
    CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1997' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM yearly_totals

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.XCL_031 > 10000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM account a
          JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
          WHERE a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
            AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
            AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.XCL_035) IN ('1996', '1997')
      )
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) AS yr,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN eligible_districts ed ON a.XCL_002 = ed.XCL_017
    WHERE t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048)
)
SELECT 
    CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1997' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM yearly_totals

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_017
    FROM district d
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
    WHERE d.XCL_027 > 10000
      AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.XCL_035) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY d.XCL_017
    HAVING COUNT(l.XCL_033) >= 1
),
card_sums AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', c.XCL_008) = '1996' THEN c.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', c.XCL_008) = '1997' THEN c.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1997
    FROM card c
    INNER JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN qualifying_districts qd ON a.XCL_002 = qd.XCL_017
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', c.XCL_008) IN ('1996', '1997')
)
SELECT 
    CAST((sum_1997 - sum_1996) AS REAL) * 100 / sum_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM card_sums

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH 
-- Step 1: Identify districts with average salary > 10,000
high_salary_districts AS (
    SELECT XCL_017 AS district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE XCL_028 > 10000
),
-- Step 2: Identify districts that had at least one active loan (status 'C' or 'D') in 1996 or 1997
active_loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_017 AS district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
      AND (strftime('%Y', l.XCL_035) = '1996' OR strftime('%Y', l.XCL_035) = '1997')
),
-- Step 3: Filter districts that meet both criteria
target_districts AS (
    SELECT hsd.district_id
    FROM high_salary_districts hsd
    INNER JOIN active_loan_districts ald ON hsd.district_id = ald.district_id
),
-- Step 4: Calculate total credit card withdrawal amounts for 1996 and 1997 for accounts in target districts
credit_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_055) AS total_withdrawal
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN target_districts td ON a.XCL_002 = td.district_id
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'withdrawal' -- Assuming 'withdrawal' is the type for credit card withdrawals
      AND (strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1996' OR strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048)
)
-- Step 5: Calculate the growth rate between 1996 and 1997
SELECT 
    ((cw1997.total_withdrawal - cw1996.total_withdrawal) / cw1996.total_withdrawal) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    (SELECT total_withdrawal FROM credit_withdrawals WHERE year = '1996') cw1996,
    (SELECT total_withdrawal FROM credit_withdrawals WHERE year = '1997') cw1997
WHERE cw1996.total_withdrawal != 0
